reading.zh: 先是入口与它的几条路由（serve / runner / flow edit / schema，其余交给能力层），然后是全局选项、参数处理与失败映射，最后是各组命令自己的一层。
reading.en: First the entry with its routes (serve / runner / flow edit / schema / everything else to the capability layer), then the global options, argument handling and the failure mapping, then one layer per command group.
